question: "The Inheritance of Loss" is written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiran Desai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kiran Desai** is an Indian author who was born in New Delhi and raised in India and England. She is the daughter of author Anita Desai.
 
• Both the National Book Critics Circle Fiction Award and the** Man Booker Prize** were won in 2006 by Kiran Desai's book The Inheritance of Loss.
